text:
CACHE::age
Description
Returns the age of the document in the cache, in seconds.
Syntax
CACHE
::
age
CACHE::age
Returns the age of the document in the cache, in seconds.
Examples
when
CACHE_REQUEST
{
if
{
[
CACHE
::
age
]
>
60
}
{
CACHE
::
expire
log
local0.
"Expiring content: Age > 60 seconds"
}
}
